cases.name: latency_only
cases.note: No priors, no history: the fastest server wins.

cases.name: priors_beat_latency
cases.note: The country prior of the fastest server is bad (Beta(1,15)), a slower one is good.

cases.name: star_prior_fallback
cases.note: No prior for the protocol: the server-level "*" prior is used.

cases.name: own_history
cases.note: This device failed twice on the fast server and worked three times on the slower one.

cases.name: history_decay
cases.note: Failures 300+ h old weigh 2^(-300/72) ≈ 0.056 each; one recent success outweighs them.

cases.name: hint_blocked
cases.note: The fastest server is in blocked_servers for the country.

cases.name: recommended_bonus
cases.note: A recommended server 15 ms slower wins by the small bonus.

cases.name: load_penalty
cases.note: A highly loaded fast server loses to a lightly loaded one.

cases.name: protocol_fit_cellular
cases.note: One server, two protocols: on cellular hysteria2 fits better.

cases.name: protocol_fit_wifi
cases.note: The same server on wifi: vless-reality fits better.

cases.name: protocol_fit_unknown_network
cases.note: Unknown network type: every protocol fits 0.5.

cases.name: latency_unknown
cases.note: VPN on, no measurement: latency feature 0 for all; priors decide.

cases.name: latency_over_cap
cases.note: 1500 ms is over the 1000 ms cap: feature 0, as for 1000 ms.

cases.name: stale_model
cases.note: A model fetched 30 h ago is stale but still used (offline).

cases.name: no_model
cases.note: No model fetched yet: Adaptive Connect 3 rules (engine ac3).

cases.name: engine_disabled
cases.note: features.ac_engine_4 is false: engine ac3 even with a model.

cases.name: unknown_model_version
cases.note: A model version the app does not know: engine ac3.

cases.name: ru_plain_never_auto
cases.note: A plain RU server (RU entry, RU exit) is never chosen automatically, even when it scores best.

cases.name: ru_only_no_choice
cases.note: Only plain RU servers: nothing is eligible, choice is null.

cases.name: bridge_allowed
cases.note: A bridge (RU entry, DE exit) may be chosen automatically.

cases.name: whitelist_bridge_first
cases.note: Whitelist mode: only whitelist_ok candidates; the bridge comes before the faster plain RU server.

cases.name: whitelist_plain_ru
cases.note: Whitelist mode without a bridge: a whitelist_ok RU server may be chosen; non-whitelist servers are not.

cases.name: whitelist_none_flagged
cases.note: Whitelist mode but no whitelist_ok server: whitelist_none, normal rules (RU still excluded).

cases.name: explore_thompson
cases.note: The first draw is under explore (0.05): Thompson samples decide.

cases.name: explore_thompson_2
cases.note: Another exploring seed.

cases.name: explore_whitelist_top_tier
cases.note: Exploration samples only the best tier: the two bridges, not the RU server.

cases.name: seed_zero
cases.note: Seed 0 is replaced by 0x9E3779B9.

cases.name: tie_break_by_key
cases.note: Equal scores: the smaller (node_id, protocol) comes first.

cases.name: city_scope_priors
cases.note: City priors: NL is blocked in the caller's city (BlockPrior(9,1)), so DE wins although NL is faster.
